subject.title: WeCom（企业微信）发送消息后 agent 无响应

question: Should OpenClaw keep this issue as a catalog-update candidate for a verified newer WeCom package, or redirect it to the external WeCom plugin until reporter logs prove an OpenClaw-core failure?
rationale: The repository only owns the official external catalog pin, while the reported runtime behavior lives in the external package and the issue lacks the version/log evidence needed to choose the repair boundary automatically.

options.title: Request trace before core work
options.body: Ask for OpenClaw version, installed WeCom plugin version, config shape, and redacted gateway/plugin logs before opening any OpenClaw fix PR.

options.title: Sponsor a catalog bump
options.body: If maintainers have independent WeCom smoke proof, update the official external catalog to a vetted fixed package version with expectedIntegrity and package compatibility evidence.

options.title: Redirect upstream
options.body: If logs show plugin-side ingress or WebSocket delivery failure, close this repository item with a link to the matching WecomTeam/wecom-openclaw-plugin issue.

recommendation.title: Request trace before core work
recommendation.body: Ask for OpenClaw version, installed WeCom plugin version, config shape, and redacted gateway/plugin logs before opening any OpenClaw fix PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The immediate OpenClaw-owned decision is the official external catalog pin and install metadata rather than the external plugin runtime itself.
